items.operation: Post-publication nine-path GitHub tree reconciliation for BASELINE-0030
items.failure: The first GitHub Trees API URL interpolated $commit?recursive as one PowerShell variable and returned HTTP 404 after all nine anonymous raw files had already matched by length and SHA-256.
items.correction: The successor resolved the exact tree SHA first and used ${treeSha}?recursive=1; all nine GitHub blob identities and sizes then matched local Git exactly.

items.failure: A 0.50 first-score ratio retained complete required evidence in only 27 of 28 eligible development cases.
items.correction: Reject the candidate before implementation; preserve required-evidence completeness as a hard gate.

items.failure: A 0.75 first-score ratio retained complete required evidence in only 26 of 28 eligible development cases.
items.correction: Reject the candidate before implementation; preserve required-evidence completeness as a hard gate.

items.failure: Keeping only records tied with the first score retained complete required evidence in only 26 of 28 eligible development cases.
items.correction: Reject the candidate before implementation; use explicit externally assigned trust-tier caps that preserve the development required-evidence set and ranks.

items.operation: Resolve the local starting tree for the preimplementation receipt
items.failure: An unquoted HEAD^{tree} revision expression was interpreted by Windows PowerShell and passed an encoded fragment to Git, producing an ambiguous-argument error alongside unusable wrapper output.
items.correction: The successor passed the revision expression as the literal string 'HEAD^{tree}' and resolved tree c36fd5b9d98c6b6049ee0e0f7ef99a1bb9fdfaa0.
